projectDesc: **PlaceTrack**: A platform designed to streamline placement drives by enabling secure authentication for students and teachers. It features slot creation, real-time location tracking with proof upload, and PDF export of filtered student data by batch and section.

**Artify AI** is an AI-powered image generator where users can sign up or log in with email and password. Users can create stunning images with prompts, view them in a history section, and easily delete or download their generated visuals for personal or professional use.

projectDesc: **ElectroVote** is a secure voting platform with roles for voters and admins. Voters sign up with Aadhaar, vote once, ensuring fairness. Admins manage elections by nominating, updating, or withdrawing candidates and tracking votes. The platform ensures transparency, reliability, and ease in conducting and managing elections.
